name: addiction
quote: He can't go a day without whiskey.
description: A strong desire for a psychoactive substance that has created a dependency.
perceptions: Doing a certain thing makes me feel better in the moment.
I've done this before, it's ok.

guidance.description: If you're struggling with an addiction that's causing problems, you should consider seeking group support or professional help.

variations.name: something you really like
variations.description: In some common usage, 'addiction' can just mean a 'strong desire' as in being 'addicted' to peanut butter. But when there's nothing psychoactive involved, it's just a strong desire or appreciation.
perceptions: I like being associated with this thing.

commentaries.quote: If you're struggling with an addiction that's causing problems, you should consider seeking professional help.

I have absolutely no pleasure in the stimulants in which I sometimes so madly indulge. It has not been in the pursuit of pleasure that I have periled life and reputation and reason. It has been the desperate attempt to escape from torturing memories, from a sense of insupportable loneliness and a dread of some strange impending doom.

Addiction is just a way of trying to get at something else. Something bigger. Call it transcendence if you want, but it’s like a rat in a maze. We all want the same thing. We all have this hole. The thing you want offers relief, but it’s a trap.
Remember that just because you hit bottom doesn’t mean you have to stay there.
